notes: ACS multi-agent-hotload 0.1.0 adopter state for Pukujan/Eval-lab (TASK-0063, issue #77). FULL PCM (4e23854, CLI 0.6.0) + FULL CGM 0.5.12 (6831f91e, eight modules) + OIO 0.1.0 pinned via stack-manifest.json (release train 2026-10-01). ACS hotload pinned at agent-custom-setup main 38f8f52 (module 0.1.0): revision bumped from e1d7732 to pick up dev-root hygiene (dev_root_check.py plus the ACS dev-root boot rule in PROMPT_INJECT.md) and the FSL-1.1-ALv2 license; module version and the PCM/CGM pins are unchanged. Boss lease is minutes (30; range 15-120); the watchdog is agent-less and liveness-only. The decision-boss seat is vacant until the first live continuer claims it.

role_fill.notes: First continuer = decision boss; next = coder1; next = coder2.

agents.notes: Seed hint for an empty room only; live join/continue order wins. Tool identity does not assign roles.

watchdog.notes: AGENT-LESS. Cron/Action/script only. No LLM. No peer agent. Watchdog != failover. ~10m liveness/nudge only.

acs.revision_note: agent-custom-setup main at 2026-10-05. pcm.notes: Full PCM for adopters. Continuity/checkpoints yes; still NOT the proposal/ACCEPT layer (that stays GitHub + PROPOSALS.md). Pin commit SHA; do not silently follow moving main. Do not vendor PCM source into ACS.
